title: Frontend offline-preview parameter defaults
description: Read-only planning references used by the bundled offline/initial preview. These values are not canonical backend inputs and do not override SimulationRequest, the parameter registry, workbook controls, or user-provided run settings.
license_or_rights: Not declared for the compiled preview dataset; source-specific rights apply.

parameters.name: AD Organic Loading Rate (OLR)
parameters.description: Volumetric organic load entering digester R301 (kg COD/m³/day).
parameters.notes: Legacy planning value; no traceable GreenHub trial dataset was found. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Protein Isoelectric Recovery Fraction
parameters.description: Legacy preview fraction for precipitation of soluble protein.
parameters.notes: REC-001 reports nitrogen-basis grass-clover juice recovery, not this soluble-protein precipitation fraction. Legacy planning value only; not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Digestate Solid Capture Efficiency
parameters.description: Planning estimate for particulate capture across screw-press/decanter separation.
parameters.notes: Engineering/pilot estimate; test-specific transfer to GreenHub is not established. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Struvite Conversion Efficiency (P basis)
parameters.description: Legacy preview conversion fraction for dissolved orthophosphate to struvite.
parameters.notes: Legacy conversion assumption; no value-level source or applicability evidence is linked. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Ammonia Stripping Efficiency
parameters.description: Planning estimate for ammonia stripping in a packed column.
parameters.notes: Pilot/engineering estimate; operating conditions and transfer to this route are not documented. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Membrane Methane Recovery Factor
parameters.description: Legacy preview methane-recovery factor for a three-stage membrane configuration.
parameters.notes: No membrane product, gas composition, pressure, or performance curve is linked. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Grass Moisture Content
parameters.description: Measured whole-grass moisture content on a wet basis.
parameters.source_title: VARTA grass nutrient report, whole-grass row 7
parameters.source_location: Greenhub_feed_inputs.xlsx, sheet 'Nutriënten Vezel', row 7; dry matter measured at 14.3%, water by difference
parameters.geography: VARTA project sample; Netherlands (site detail not recorded in workbook row)
parameters.basis: 85.7% wet-basis moisture = 1 - measured dry matter fraction 0.143.
parameters.notes: VARTA 2026-10-27 whole-grass sample; measured dry matter 14.3%, moisture by difference 85.7% wet basis. Replaces the stale 78% preview value.

parameters.name: Digester Operating Temperature
parameters.description: Legacy preview operating setpoint for the digester.
parameters.notes: 38 °C is a legacy operating-setpoint assumption, not a measured GreenHub digester observation. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: ADM1 Particulate Disintegration Rate (k_dis)
parameters.description: Legacy placeholder for a first-order ADM1 disintegration constant.
parameters.notes: The active GreenHub anaerobic-digestion pathway is not ADM1; this constant is not connected to the backend pathway.

parameters.name: Isoelectric Precipitation Target pH
parameters.description: Legacy preview target pH for protein precipitation.
parameters.notes: 4.2 is a legacy target-setpoint assumption, not a measured controller record or validated GreenHub optimum. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Struvite Standard Solubility Product (pKsp)
parameters.description: Standard activity-based struvite equilibrium constant at 25 °C.
parameters.source_title: Struvite precipitation thermodynamics in source-separated urine
parameters.source_location: Ronteltap, Maurer & Gujer (2007), standard solubility product at 25 °C
parameters.basis: pKsp = 13.26 ± 0.057 at 25 °C; standard activity-based equilibrium constant, not a conditional GreenHub-liquor value.
parameters.notes: Direct literature constant; applicability to process liquor still depends on ionic strength and speciation. Planning reference only; not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Ammonia Stripping Air-to-Liquid Ratio (G/L)
parameters.description: Legacy engineering estimate of volumetric air-to-liquid ratio in a packed stripping tower.
parameters.notes: Blower-sizing design calculation; no operating measurement is supplied. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Membrane CO2/CH4 Ideal Selectivity
parameters.description: Legacy preview ideal CO2/CH4 selectivity ratio for a polyimide membrane.
parameters.notes: No manufacturer, product sheet, gas composition, pressure basis, or operating conditions are linked. Not applied to backend runs.

parameters.name: Vacuum Evaporator Steam Economy Ratio
parameters.description: Engineering estimate of evaporated water per motive steam in a multi-effect evaporator.
parameters.notes: Triple-effect vacuum-evaporator model estimate; plant-specific test data are absent. Not applied to backend runs.
